mission: Turn the FDTD design corpus into a codegen-complete, benchmark-driven, implementation-ready package bootstrap.

items.title: Freeze the backend-neutral solver IR schema
outputs: A machine-readable solver IR schema with stable field names, enums, defaults, validation rules, and feature capability descriptors
Examples for a minimal vacuum simulation, a dispersive/PML simulation, and an adjoint-enabled simulation
success_criteria: An implementation generator can construct field buffers, stage graphs, and kernel specialization keys without inventing fields
The schema is independent of backend implementation language

items.title: Freeze the geometry and materialization IR schema
outputs: A machine-readable geometry schema for primitives, transforms, material assignments, boolean composition, and parameter bindings
A machine-readable rasterization/materialization schema for voxel, face, and edge coefficients
success_criteria: Forward initialization and adjoint geometry differentiation share the same discretization contract
Chunk-local broad-phase inputs and candidate-list outputs are explicitly represented

items.title: Freeze the source, monitor, DFT, near-to-far, and adjoint operator schema
outputs: A machine-readable operator schema for forward sources, monitors, mode operators, near-to-far operators, and adjoint source maps
Reference examples for time-domain, frequency-domain, and hybrid adjoint cases
success_criteria: Monitor-to-source transformations do not require hidden implementation assumptions
Interpolation and restriction directions are explicit

items.title: Freeze Meep and Tidy3D compatibility manifests
outputs: An exact Meep API compatibility target manifest
An exact Tidy3D API compatibility target manifest
A list of intentionally out-of-scope non-core workflows
success_criteria: A generator can produce adapters without guessing signature or object-shape details
Parity targets and exclusions are explicit

items.title: Freeze the multi-GPU chunking, halo, and reduction protocol
outputs: A protocol spec for chunk ownership, halo extents, pack order, reduction semantics, overlap schedule, and monitor aggregation
Reference communication traces for one-dimensional and three-dimensional decompositions
success_criteria: Two independent implementations pack and exchange identical buffers
All field staggering conventions are encoded, not implied

items.title: Freeze rich material plugin contracts
outputs: Discrete constitutive-update contracts for Lorentz, Drude, gyrotropic, Kerr, and other target material families
State-layout and kernel-variant descriptors for each material family
success_criteria: A generator can emit material state updates without inventing constitutive equations
Variant explosion is controlled through capability descriptors rather than manual kernel families

items.title: Freeze correctness, performance, and workload benchmark manifests
outputs: A machine-readable benchmark manifest with kernel, solver, device, and workflow tiers
Golden outputs and tolerances for accuracy checks
A workload suite drawn from metalens, Tidy3D notebooks, silicon-photonics devices, and distributed stress cases
success_criteria: A benchmark harness can run without per-case human interpretation
Performance regressions and correctness regressions are separable

items.title: Freeze the accuracy policy and feature-tier tolerances
outputs: A tiered accuracy policy for vacuum, dielectric, dispersive, adjoint, mode-solver, and distributed features
A document explaining when numerical differences are acceptable and when they are failures
success_criteria: Accuracy gates are exact enough for automated CI and benchmark triage
Tolerance policy is attached to features, not buried in prose

items.title: Complete the discrete mode-solver implementation contract
outputs: A discrete operator contract for the vector mode solver across supported boundary types
Normalization, orthogonality, batching, and adjoint-through-eigensolve contracts
success_criteria: Mode source and monitor generation can be implemented against a fixed contract
PML and lossy-mode policy is explicit

items.title: Create the package scaffold for generated backends, tests, and benchmark harnesses
outputs: A concrete package layout for generated kernels, handwritten runtime code, frontend adapters, tests, and benchmarks
A documented codegen boundary between generated artifacts and handwritten control code
success_criteria: The repo layout supports easy installation, testing, and iterative backend generation
Generated and handwritten code boundaries are explicit and reviewable

items.title: Curate the canonical silicon-photonics and large-scale device suite
outputs: A curated device set spanning MMI, demultiplexers, waveguide bends, metalenses, antennas, and distributed stress cases
A mapping from each device to the physics features and monitors it exercises
success_criteria: The suite stresses both accuracy and throughput across realistic photonics workloads
Single-GPU and multi-GPU headroom can be evaluated from the same manifest
